id.description: The unique and required id of this instance.

issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

toolName.description: Semantic name for the tool. Used for agent prompts.

toolDescription.description: Natural language description for the tool. Used for agent prompts.

formattingMessage.description:
Natural language message appended prior to llm generation. Helps prompt the agent to correctly format to tool input.
Ignored if not provided.

e.g. "\n[SYSTEM MESSAGE: {toolName} requires inputing a start date and end date.]"

examples.description: Array of {@link Genai.Agent.Tool.Example}s for this tool.

uiOptions.description:
Configuration for how this will be shown as a UI drop-down option if {@link Genai.Agent.Config}
uiToolOptions includes this tool.

overrideRuntimeKwargs.description:
Runtime keywords arguments passed into the tool. Enables overriding of default behavior such
 as default prompts for specific sub tools.

 Format of configs for the {@link Genai.Agent.Tool.UnstructuredDataQuery}:
```json
 {
    "find_time_information_kwargs": {
        "default_span": dict,
        "default_interval": str,
        "default_interval_thresholds": dict,
        "default_timezone": dict,
        "default_timezone_offset": dict,
        "find_start_time_information_prompt": str,
        "find_end_time_information_prompt": str,
    }
 }
```

retrievedDataDescription.description: Description for data returned by {@link Genai.Agent.Tool.DataRetriever.Output}

nativeToolDocumentationOverride.description:
The default tool description will be derived from the python signature and docstring for
the function returned by {@link Genai.Agent.Tool.FunctionCalling#pyFuncForAgent}. If provided, values in this
dictionary will override those from the generated description.

* name: The name of the tool/function
* description: A brief description of the tool/function (normally derived from the docstring)
* parameters: A dict of (parameter name, python type string) pairs
             (e.g. {"currency": {"type": "str"}, "value": {"type": "float"}})
* return_type: The python type string of the return value (e.g. "dict")

NOTE: due to issues with serializing the 'type' key, you may set nativeToolDocumentationOverride to a JSON string
representation (or json.dumps from python) of the dictionary instead of the dictionary itself.

serializeInputsForFunctionCall.description:
If true, the {@link Genai.Agent.Planner} will serialize inputs for the function call.
Otherwise, the in-memory references will be passed.

extractTimeInfoFromQuery.description: If set to true then the time information will be extracted from the query and search results will be filtered on #dateFieldToFilter

dateFieldToFilter.description: {@link Genai.SourceFile.Metadata} field to filter on when #extractTimeInfoFromQuery is set to true

configName.description:
The name of the {@link Genai.UnstructuredQuery.Engine.Config} that this tool should use.
If not set, then the default pipeline config will be used.

pipelineConfigName.description:
The name of the {@link Genai.UnstructuredQuery.Engine.REA.PipelineConfig} that this tool should use.
If not set, then the default pipeline config will be used.
